# Compliance Check - Key Actions

This document details essential actions for maintaining regulatory compliance and managing legal risks.

## Monitoring and Updates:

*   Monitor regulatory changes on a quarterly basis.
*   Monitor legal risks relevant to the 2026 strategy.
*   Update legal risks based on audit findings.
*   Optimize regulatory changes based on audit findings.
*   Investigate regulatory changes based on audit findings.
